# Lakehouse Architect
> The Definitive Enterprise Reference Platform for Lakehouse Architecture, Medallion Architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark 4.0, and Distributed Systems.

Website: https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app
Canonical Domain: https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app
Platform Edition: 2026 Enterprise Edition
Author: Santosh Jammi

## Overview
Lakehouse Architect is an open-access enterprise architecture encyclopedia and preparation portal engineered for Principal Data Architects, Staff Data Engineers, and Lead Analytics Engineers. It provides 10,700+ verified interview scenarios, 660+ architectural concepts, 32 digital whiteboard blueprints, and dedicated Spark execution labs.

## Core Architecture Pillars & Hubs
- [Lakehouse Architecture Hub](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/architecture): 3,206+ production system design scenarios, distributed failure modes, and architectural trade-offs.
- [Concepts & Foundations Glossary](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/concepts): 660+ core lakehouse concepts covering Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Unity Catalog, and Medallion patterns.
- [Concepts Mind Map](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/mindmap): Interactive multi-level stretching taxonomy linking all 660+ concepts to architectural domains.
- [Spark Engine Lab](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/spark-engine): Interactive physical execution simulator, Tungsten memory geometry, and shuffle stage mechanics for Apache Spark 4.0.
- [QA Prep Portal](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/qa-prep): 7,081+ verified interview drills covering DP-600, DP-203, and Databricks Professional exams.
- [Production Cheat Sheets](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/cheat-sheet): 117+ high-density runbooks, Sev-1 incident codes, and Delta Lake optimization commands.
- [DataOps Lifecycle](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/dataops): End-to-end data platform CI/CD, Git integration, schema evolution, and deployment pipelines.
- [Modern Data Stack Hub](https://lakehousearchitect.vercel.app/modern-stack): 18 blueprints comparing Delta Lake vs Apache Iceberg, dbt Core, Kafka, and LLM RAG pipelines.

## Key Technologies Covered
- Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Direct Lake, Synapse Data Engineering, Data Factory)
- Databricks Lakehouse (Unity Catalog, Photon Engine, Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing)
- Open Table Formats (Delta Lake 3.x, Apache Iceberg V2, Apache Hudi)
- Distributed Query & Compute (Apache Spark 4.0, Trino, DuckDB, Velox)
- Medallion Architecture (Bronze: Raw Ingestion, Silver: Conformed/Cleaned, Gold: Curated Dimensional Marts)
